documentation.rationale: The identity half is present: VIN shown and decoding cleanly to a 2021 MX-5 Sport convertible, stock number, single asking price. The maintenance half (records, history report, title or accident data) is absent from what was captured. The detail page was not fetched, so this is not a judgement that the seller withholds it.

condition.rationale: Nothing wrong is stated and nothing is proven either way: no photos, no records, no inspection. At 61k miles, clutch wear, water-pump weep, brake fluid and tires are open questions rather than observed faults.

price_value.rationale: The $23,034 asking price sits slightly above the $22,679 fair-value midpoint, near the top of the $19,597-23,578 band. That is for a base Sport with fairly high 61k miles and no captured history. A 2023 Sport with 36k miles is asking $23,941, which makes this car look full-priced.

mission_fit.rationale: Manual ND2 with the better 181 hp engine: a reliable, inspectable, easily resold enthusiast bridge, and the Miata is back in consideration. Asking is above the $19,000 ideal band but under the $27,000 ceiling.

logistics.rationale: La Habra is roughly 320 miles from Carmel, a fly-in and drive-home trip. A dealer lot in the LA basin should make an independent PPI easy, though access is not stated in the captured text. CA-registered, and smog should be routine.

emotional_spec_fit.rationale: A typical ND2 manual Sport in Arctic White. It has no Club limited-slip differential, Bilstein dampers or Brembo/BBS package, and no documented originality. The leather claim is unverified.

ppi_focus: Clutch engagement point and slip test in 4th-6th under load; check the hydraulics for leaks
Gearbox: synchro grind into 2nd and 3rd when warm, and popping out of gear
Water pump weep hole and coolant crust; coolant condition
Oil seepage at the valve cover, timing cover and front crank seal, the rear diff pinion and output seals, and any rear main seal weep
Soft-top fabric rub-through at the rear corners and header, drains clear, footwell underlay dry, seat-rail bolts free of corrosion
Paint meter and panel gaps for accident repair, given the unknown history; check the aluminum hood and fenders for dents and respray
Brake fluid moisture test, pad and rotor thickness, tire DOT dates and wear pattern (shoulder wear suggests track use)
Suspension noises: end links, front lower control arm bushings, rear subframe and toe links
Scan for stored codes and confirm recall 24V695000 status by VIN
Verify the interior is the trim the listing claims, and check for removed modifications
what_would_change_verdict: A clean history report (one or two owners, no accidents, not a rental) plus dated service records including brake fluid would raise documentation and condition
A clean independent PPI with a healthy clutch and no leaks would raise condition
A negotiated price nearer the low end of the fair-value band would raise price value
A branded title, accident damage, track-use evidence, a slipping clutch or water intrusion would move it sharply down
evidence.mission_note: A manual ND2 Miata directly fits the enthusiast-bridge brief: reliable, fun on Highway 1, and easy to resell in 6-24 months. At $23,034 it is over the ideal band but under the ceiling, so the case rests on history and PPI results.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes identity: the VIN decodes to a 2021 MX-5 Sport soft top with the 2.0L engine, with no year, trim or body conflicts. The listing also gives a 6-speed manual, 61,000 miles and a $23,034 asking price. The VIN falls in scope of NHTSA recall 24V695000 for airbag control module software; whether it is closed is undocumented. Nothing mechanical is observed wrong, but nothing is proven: no photos, records, title, owner or accident data were captured, and the dealer listing says history is not shown. The 'black leather seats' description does not match a typical US Sport trim and needs clarifying. At 61k miles the clutch, water pump, fluids and tires sit in typical wear windows. Price is slightly above the computed fair-value midpoint for a base trim with above-average mileage.
evidence.next_action: Call Dapper Car Sales to request the Carfax/AutoCheck for this VIN, the recall 24V695000 completion status and any service records, and confirm they will allow an independent PPI in the La Habra area before any deposit.
